title: Best friends, by element
caption:
Every friendship is two elements in a trench coat.

Air and Earth: one brings the invites, one remembers every inside joke. Fire and Water: one booked it, one brings the calm. Water and Water: 'we should get chai soon', every three months, for eleven years, both delighted.

Send this to your best friend and tell them which pair you are.
